channel.title: GiveOwl – Giveaways & sweepstakes in Ireland
channel.description: Every listing links to the organizer’s official rules. GiveOwl never collects your entries.

item.title: NORMAL's Big Christmas Dice Game 2026: play daily for a €1,234 gift card – Normal Retail Ireland Limited
item.description: Prize: More than 24,122 dice prizes (NORMAL products such as Soft & Chewy, hand soap, mints, Skittles, Kodak batteries, face masks, chewing gum; collect from a NORMAL store in Ireland within 7 days) and the grand prize: a NORMAL gift card worth €1,234 (sent by email). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Sign up with your email at games.normal.ie/dicegame and confirm the link, then complete the daily challenge once per day from 23 November to 24 December 2026 to see instantly whether you won a prize or entries into the grand prize draw. Free; you agree to receive NORMAL newsletters. 16+, one email address per person

item.title: American Songwriter Holiday Giveaway 2026: a $2,129 music-gear package (guitar, audio interface, monitors and more) – American Songwriter (Savage Ventures)
item.description: Prize: One winner gets 7 pieces of gear: Sterling by Music Man Cutlass Plus HSS guitar, Focusrite Scarlett 16i16 4th Gen, ADAM Audio D3V monitors + H200 headphones + D3V travel bag, Lutefish Stream, Novation Launchkey Mini 25 MK4 (total retail value $2,129). Deadline: December 17, 2026. Fill in the free entry form on the American Songwriter Holiday Giveaway 2026 page. Optional: share your link for 2 bonus entries per friend who enters. Open to entrants 13+ worldwide, void where prohibited. Nov 19 – Dec 17, 2026, 11:59 PM Central. No purchase necessary

item.title: Win a €500 Ireland’s Blue Book gift voucher – The Irish Times
item.description: Prize: An Ireland’s Blue Book gift voucher worth €500 (stays and experiences at Blue Book country houses, castles and restaurants). Deadline: December 4, 2026. Answer the question in the entry form on the Irish Times competition page and add your name, email address and phone number. Free; one entry per person. Residents of Ireland aged 18+. 20 November – midday 4 December 2026

item.title: Clean & Neat Great Christmas Clean-Up: play the free game and win a 4-hour Christmas clean – Clean & Neat (C&N House and Garden Doctors Ltd, Donabate, Co. Dublin)
item.description: Prize: One 4-hour home clean by the Clean & Neat team (worth over €100) before 24 December 2026, for a home in County Dublin (can be given to a Dublin home). Deadline: December 15, 2026. Play the free game at cleanandneat.ie/xmas-game/ and add your email or mobile number on the end screen; the highest score saved before the deadline wins (game of skill). No purchase, booking or social media needed. 18+, living in the Republic of Ireland. 18 Nov – 15 Dec 2026 23:59

item.title: BOOHOOMAN Black Friday £1K Cash Comp: win £1,000 cash (Ireland) – BOOHOOMAN (Boohoo.com UK Limited)
item.description: Prize: £1,000 cash or the equivalent in euro (1 winner across all participating countries). Deadline: November 27, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the BOOHOOMAN Black Friday Countdown page with first name, last name, email and date of birth (mobile optional); you agree to BOOHOOMAN marketing emails. Free, no purchase. Open to 18+ residents of the UK, Ireland, the US, France, Germany, the Netherlands and Australia. 9 Nov (09:30 GMT) – 27 Nov 2026 23:59 GMT; one winner announced by email on 30 Nov 2026

item.title: Irish Times: win a stay at The Green Hotel with dinner and ice skating at TwinkleTown – The Irish Times, The Green Hotel & TwinkleTown
item.description: Prize: One-night stay at The Green Hotel, Dublin, with breakfast and dinner, plus two tickets for ice skating at TwinkleTown Smithfield. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Answer the competition question and submit your name, email and phone number in the form on irishtimes.com. Free, one entry per person. Residents of Ireland aged 18+. Closes midnight 27.11.2026

item.title: O'Haras of Foxford Hamper Giveaway: win one of 10 bakery hampers – O'Haras of Foxford
item.description: Prize: 10 hampers of O'Haras bakery favourites (Baker51 sourdough cobs, Lemon Drizzle Cake, Premium Fruit Cake and more) including a limited-edition 75 years mug. Deadline: December 5, 2026. Submit your name and email in the entry form on oharasoffoxford.com/hamper-giveaway. Free, no purchase, one entry per person. Republic of Ireland residents 18+. Closes 11:59 pm on 5 December 2026; winners announced 8 December

item.title: Sandberg: Advent Calendar – December 2026 (Ireland) – Sandberg A/S
item.description: Prize: A daily contest behind each door; 2026 prizes not published yet. Deadline: December 24, 2026. From 1 to 24 December open the day’s door on sandberg.ie and take part in the day’s contest. Free Sandberg account required (16+). No purchase

item.title: Kraken: A Christmas Call with Poldi – win a video call with Lukas Podolski – Kraken (Payward Ltd.)
item.description: Prize: Ten winners each get a place on a 30-minute group video call with Lukas Podolski in the week of December 15–19, 2026 (ARV $500 each, $5,000 total). Deadline: December 1, 2026. Complete the entry form on the promotion landing page with your name and email address. Free: no purchase, deposit, trade or other financial activity is required. One entry per person. 18+ (or age of majority) residing in the EEA, the United States (excl. Maine, New York, Florida, Puerto Rico), Canada (excl. Quebec) and other jurisdictions where Kraken services are available; residents of the UK, Australia and Switzerland are not eligible. Runs Nov 1 – Dec 1, 2026, 23:59 UTC; 10 winners drawn after the close. Canadian winners must answer a skill-testing question.

item.title: Nat Geo Kids: win 8 HarperCollins children’s books – National Geographic Kids (Creature Media Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One winner gets eight HarperCollins children’s books, incl. Black Beauty: A Retelling, The Magician’s Nephew and The Very Last Christmas Present. Deadline: December 9, 2026. Answer the question in the form on the competition page. For children 16 or under, resident in the UK or Ireland (ask a parent). Free, one entry per person. Closes 23:59 on 9 December 2026

item.title: Nat Geo Kids: win the Maisie Vs book series (website quest) – National Geographic Kids (Creature Media Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One reader wins all three Maisie Vs books (Antarctica, the Himalayas, the Pyramids). Deadline: December 11, 2026. Follow the clues around the Nat Geo Kids website, then enter the page where you found the treasure in the form. For children 16 or under, resident in the UK or Ireland. Free, one entry per person. Closes 23:59 on 11 December 2026

item.title: Win with FALKEN – Bike Giveaway: BULLS e-trail or carbon gravel bikes – SOKRATIV GmbH (with Dunlop Tyre Europe / BULLS / ZEG)
item.description: Prize: 1× BULLS Copperhead EVO AM 2 e-trail bike (RRP €4,999) and 3× BULLS Machete RX 1 carbon gravel bikes (RRP €1,999 each). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the free participation form on win-with-falken.com, select a bike and confirm terms. No purchase of FALKEN tyres required. One entry per person. Open to residents 18+ in Belgium, Bulgaria, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Czech Republic or Hungary. Closes Nov 30, 2026 at 18:00

item.title: Coca-Cola Christmas 2026: Win a Lapland trip for 4 – Coca-Cola Ireland
item.description: Prize: Grand prize: Lapland trip for 4 (flights Dublin–Rovaniemi, 3 nights 4* hotel, Northern Lights and snowmobile tours). Weekly prizes: baubles, gloves, socks, Omniplex cinema tickets and €/£10 Just Eat vouchers. Deadline: December 28, 2026. Register in the Coca-Cola App and answer the weekly question (no purchase necessary, max 2 entries per day). ROI and NI residents 18+. 8 weekly draws.

item.title: JACK & JONES Advent Calendar (Ireland) – JACK & JONES (Bestseller)
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (last edition: daily prizes and a grand prize of 20 gift cards worth €1,000 in total). Last edition: return every day to the advent calendar page on jackjones.com (Ireland) for a new chance to win. 2026 details not announced yet

item.title: Marketsz Major Sweepstake: win an iPhone 18 Pro – Marketsz Inc.
item.description: Prize: One iPhone 18 Pro (ARV $890) plus 1 year of Marketsz membership. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free entry: create a free Marketsz account to receive ballots, or enter by the free email method described in the official rules. Open worldwide where legal, 18+. Ends December 31, 2026

item.title: Draíocht Blanchardstown 25th Birthday: win two show tickets every month – Draíocht Blanchardstown
item.description: Prize: Two free tickets to a Draíocht show, drawn monthly (25 pairs per month in the first half of 2026). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in Draíocht's online form (name, address, email, phone; free, no purchase); one entry stays in all remaining monthly draws. 18+, living in Leinster, one entry per household. Closes 30 Nov 2026

item.title: Trampolines Ireland Christmas BERG go-kart draw – Trampolines Ireland
item.description: Prize: A BERG Buddy B.Orange go-kart (worth €299), delivered free. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Submit your email address on trampolinesireland.com (free, no purchase; joining the mailing list is optional). 18+, residents of the Republic of Ireland or Northern Ireland, one entry per person. Closes 11:59pm Mon 30 Nov 2026 (extended on 6 Nov); draw Tue 1 Dec 2026, winner contacted by email.

item.title: Primark Ireland €100 gift card prize draw – Primark Ireland
item.description: Prize: A €100 Primark gift card. Deadline: December 15, 2026. Enter your email and date of birth on Primark's online form (free, no purchase; entering means signing up to Primark emails). 18+, Republic of Ireland residents only (not Northern Ireland), one entry per person. 15 Sep to 15 Dec 2026

item.title: DEWALT UK & Ireland newsletter monthly prize draw (£600 tool bundle) – DEWALT (Stanley Black & Decker UK)
item.description: Prize: A DEWALT hand tool and storage bundle worth £600 RRP, drawn every month. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Subscribe to the DEWALT mailing list on dewalt.co.uk/newsletter (full name, email, trade); active subscribers are entered into each monthly draw (opting in to promotional emails is the entry route). No purchase necessary, one entry per person. 18+, residents of the UK (incl. Northern Ireland) or the Republic of Ireland. 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026

item.title: Duracell Scan & Win 2026 – Real Madrid v Barcelona trip – Duracell
item.description: Prize: Six winners each get two prize bundles (Real Madrid v Barcelona 2027 match ticket, stadium tour, club jersey and scarf) plus £1,000/€ equivalent towards travel and accommodation. Open to UK and Republic of Ireland residents aged 18+. ROI entries must answer a skill question.. Deadline: December 31, 2026. Scan the QR code in store or go to duracellscanwin.com/en-ie, fill in your full name and email and correctly answer the skill question (“Name a player currently playing in La Liga”). Republic of Ireland residents 18+, up to 4 entries per person, no purchase required. 1 Jun – 31 Dec 2026

item.title: Visit Belfast 12 Days of Christmas Giveaway – Visit Belfast
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (last year: 12 daily prizes such as hotel stays, restaurant and shopping vouchers and event tickets in Belfast). Deadline: December 12, 2026. Last year you entered each daily prize on visitbelfast.com between 1 and 12 Dec (NI and ROI residents, 18+). Nothing is announced for 2026 yet

item.title: IMAGE Advent Calendar giveaway – IMAGE.ie
item.description: Prize: Not confirmed for 2026 (last year: a prize every day in December, e.g. hotel stays, beauty and vouchers, and a grand prize of all prizes on the last day). Deadline: December 24, 2026. Last year readers entered daily on image.ie through December. Nothing is announced for 2026 yet, and the entry steps were not readable on last year's page

item.title: Royal Collection Trust: Win a Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper – Royal Collection Trust
item.description: Prize: Buckingham Palace Christmas Hamper (£150), posted worldwide. Deadline: December 1, 2026. Fill in your details on the Royal Collection Shop competition page; one entry per person/email, no purchase. Postage paid worldwide. Closes 1 Dec 2026, 23:59 GMT
